about: Summary of runs 5, 6 and 7 of the 30 prepared cases (2026-11-12, after the investigator prompt was changed a third time on these same 30 cases: the verdict order is store, then agent, then undetermined, then buyer; if the store did not charge or ship what the agent ordered, the store comes first), hold-out 1 and 2, and the abuse run, from the raw evidence files (not committed: they hold sandbox account and PayPal order identifiers). Identifiers removed; case ids S01-S30, H01-H10 and X01-X10 refer to scenarios/cases.json, scenarios/holdout.json, scenarios/holdout2.json, scenarios/holdout3.json (Y-A01 to Y-D10) and scenarios/holdout3-codex.json (Y01 to Y12). Sandbox only; the cases, agent logs and answer keys were written by us (hold-out 2 by a separate agent that had not read the prompt). The README table shows run 7. Run 8 (commit bac3742, the merged build, desk fund $2,000 at the start) and hold-out 3 (40 cases) and hold-out 3 Codex (12 cases) were added after. Runs 1-4 and the live-agent run are in 2026-11-12-summary.json and the README.

holdout3.written: by four writers, 10 cases each, who did not read the prompt, the earlier cases or the measured results; answer key 10 STORE, 10 AGENT, 10 BUYER, 10 UNDETERMINED

holdout3Codex.written: by Codex (a different model), 3 cases per answer; no case removed; Codex reported that it read scenarios/cases.json once while writing and did not look at it again from the fourth case on

conditions.condition: 1. The same order is reported twice (two reports at the same moment)
conditions.observed: refunds on the PayPal order: 1; refund calls sent: 1; second report marked duplicate: true

conditions.condition: 2. The same refund request is sent again (same request id)
conditions.observed: PayPal answered with the first refund (same id); refunds on the PayPal order: 1

conditions.condition: 3. The amount is over the per-case limit ($50)
conditions.expected: checked first, no refund before the verdict
conditions.observed: $92.95: path VERIFY_FIRST (OVER_PER_CASE_CAP); refunds on the PayPal order right after the report: 0; after the verdict (AGENT): 1

conditions.condition: 4. More instant refunds than the 30-day count allows (2)
conditions.observed: paths: REFUND_FIRST -> REFUND_FIRST -> VERIFY_FIRST; third order refunds on PayPal at report: 0 (OVER_30_DAY_COUNT)

conditions.condition: 5. The buyer withdraws save-for-later consent before the charge
conditions.observed: verdict BUYER; re-charge HALTED (NO_ACTIVE_CONSENT); charge calls accepted by PayPal: 0; store PAID from desk:reserve

conditions.condition: 6. The buyer disputes during the notice period
conditions.observed: verdict BUYER; re-charge HALTED (BUYER_DISPUTED); charge calls accepted by PayPal: 0

conditions.expected: buyer keeps the refund, no re-charge
conditions.observed: verdict UNDETERMINED (R3); refund kept; charge calls accepted by PayPal: 0

conditions.condition: 8. A re-charge above the amount fixed at purchase is requested
conditions.expected: refused; only the fixed amount can be charged
conditions.observed: request for $35.99 refused (OVER_LIABILITY_CAP), calls sent: 0; then charged $34.99 = the refunded amount

conditions.condition: 9. The re-charge is requested twice (at the same moment, then once more)
conditions.observed: charge calls accepted by PayPal: 1; answers: charged, CHARGE_IN_PROGRESS, then ALREADY_CHARGED

promptChange4.about: Fourth change to the investigator prompt (commit ab310ba, 2026-11-13 00:04 KST): a free extra that nobody was charged for is not a departure from the order; one rule for the step that goes over the spending limit (the add_to_cart step if the cart's item total is already over it, the pay step if only shipping, tax or fees take it over); a step-by-step comparison, with the first deviation answered in the order STEP, then INSUFFICIENT, then NONE. All runs here use scripts/ai-eval.mjs with PayPal in memory (no sandbox money), claude-haiku-5-5. 'before' runs use the prompt of commit e528e38 (the same prompt as 14216bb); 'after' runs use ab310ba/a221b07.

holdout4.fixedAt: 2026-11-13T00:08:22+09:00 (commit a221b07), after the prompt change (00:04) and before the first AI run on these cases (log start 00:08:32)
holdout4.written: by two writers, 12 cases each, who did not open src/ai, scenarios, the measured results or earlier case files (their own report); answer key 6 STORE, 6 AGENT, 6 BUYER, 6 UNDETERMINED
caveats: targeted: the writing brief named the shapes to include and how to judge them (free extras, the step that goes over the limit, cases changed before paying), so this set checks those shapes; it does not show generalization

Z-B05: the answer key says BUYER, all four runs closed it UNDETERMINED with both keys; the product page gives only "85% merino wool" against a "no cotton blend" exclusion, so the key is open to dispute; the key was not changed and the case counts as wrong
quickClose is false for all 24 cases, but code alone closes 6 of them in the quick check (Z-A04, Z-A07, Z-A09, Z-B02, Z-B04, Z-B08); quick-check numbers are not used

firstStepDefinitionConflict.note: the changed prompt answers INSUFFICIENT when no step departs and a fact is unknown; the fixed answer keys of hold-out 3 and the Codex cases say NONE for these six, so they are not scored on the same rule; scores below use the fixed keys as written
